scope: Local scripted-provider timing extraction from the successful packaged chat workflow on one Apple M4 Pro / macOS 27 development host. Provider inference is a local fixture, not a network or live-provider measurement.
decision: The normal visual fixture is dominated by local compilation; the deliberately slow review fixture is dominated by its fixture review delay. Neither value measures provider latency. Capture authorized network/provider timings separately before ranking network or model optimizations.
limits: Chat test executes many behavioral branches, not a statistically designed timing corpus.
Timings omit input-event/renderer-compositor timestamps and do not isolate archive checkpoint work.
No OpenAI, Anthropic, compatible endpoint, Codex, or Claude account was contacted.
